title: DEPARTMENT’S REPORT dated November 5, 2026, relative to a donation valued at $12,500.00 to
text:
[3. CONSENT AGENDA ITEMS]
DEPARTMENT’S REPORT dated November 5, 2026, relative to a donation valued at $12,500.00 to
  support Office of Operations, Community Engagement Group, Police Orientation Preparation Program
  (POPP), as set forth.  [BPC #26-355]

  Recommendation(s) for Board action:

  APPROVE the Department’s report and ACCEPT the donation.
summary: The Police Commission is asked to accept a $12,500 donation to support the Police Orientation Preparation Program (POPP) in the Office of Operations.
